# Security policy

This is a static personal portfolio. It has no backend, accounts or user data, and every demonstration runs in the visitor's browser on hypothetical inputs.

To report a vulnerability or an exposed secret, email krishivramchandani@gmail.com or open a private security advisory on this repository. Please do not post details publicly first.

Automated checks on every pull request and weekly: secret scanning (gitleaks, trufflehog), static analysis (semgrep, CodeQL), vulnerability, secret and configuration scanning (trivy), dependency review, and OpenSSF Scorecard. Dependabot proposes npm and Actions updates.
